method.description: free text: on FR/NFR this is the Verification cell, owned by spec-artifacts-process's lint rule (ISO 29148 methods plus its catalog method ids); on StR this is the Validation cell, owned by this module's advisory `vc-validation-method` rule (the four ISO 29148 methods). The census counts 1,144 distinct spellings over 21,181 cells, of which those admitted spellings are the large majority, and a schema that closed the vocabulary would reject the corpus it describes.

annotation.description: free text: the parenthesized remainder of the cell, verbatim, so the split loses nothing the author wrote.

description:
A verification or validation cell split by the `typed-table` mapping. The
skeletons author a plain cell — `Test` is `method: Test`, `testRefs: []`,
no `annotation`. A cell still carrying parentheses splits into `method`,
`annotation` (the text between the first `(` and the last `)` verbatim, so
no byte of the authored cell is dropped), and `testRefs` (the `TC-nnn`
tokens found in `annotation`). The split keeps parsing that shape for a
caller that still authors one, but a criterion binds to its tests by
criterion id, not a cell annotation.
